name: local-amp
description: A local FFmpeg-backed music player with playlists and metadata extraction.

scripts.test: node --experimental-test-isolation=none --test tests/*.test.js && cd backend && cargo test --locked
scripts.lint:frontend: eslint public scripts tests eslint.config.js --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/check-frontend-links.js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && cd backend && cargo fmt -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
